leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a Vue component that fetches and displays asynchronous data
Configure loading states and error handling for async operations
Initialize and manage reactive data properties for async component state
Bind async data to template elements using Vue directives
Construct mock API responses for testing async component behavior
Integrate lifecycle hooks to control when async data is fetched
Render conditional UI elements based on async data loading status
